cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a self-service car wash — open wash bays with foam brushes, a coiled high-pressure hose, wet tiled floor and a vacuum post
cuts.scene: she is the manager of the car wash standing with a hand on her hip, looking over a row of gleaming cars
cuts.outfit: a car wash attendant look fitted to her body — a cropped waterproof jacket tied under the chest over short denim shorts and rubber boots, bare midriff and legs, a gold-trimmed visor
